implemented.heading: Persistent movement client accepts relative orientation or absolute IMU heading. Execution-time anchor, shortest route, exact antipode left, <=0.35rad/s,0.05rad tolerance,0.3s distinct capture-time dwell, hard timeout. Physical angle accuracy unaccepted.
implemented.heading_verification: Distinct fresh applied observations must match a causally earlier requested command within0.2s and existing0.02 component tolerance. This is bounded compatibility, not measured transport latency. Zero confirmation remains separate.
implemented.tactics: Explicit expiring auto intent selects offense/defense per robot. External intents replace ownership; no auto fallback on lease loss. Defender preserves facing toward ball while repositioning.
implemented.referee: Nonzero goal pulses latch only after whole valid frame admission, including holds without motion authority. Every action yields to goal return before target lookup.
implemented.resume: Explicit session-checked per-robot resume references exact current field frame, completed return, correct home position/heading, cleared goal, current lease and clear configured camera. No queued reset or renewed authority.
implemented.software_start: Resident helper and session Start freeze a challenge at actual input receipt. No discovery wait, newer-status repair, automatic retry or homing. Initial ordinary Stop may release; subsequent Stop epoch/gateway instance changes end session. Pending/uncertain exit requests emergency Stop. Real ROS integration result recorded separately when complete.
